items.description: <App> rendered in MemoryRouter with initialEntries={["/stock/file"]} mounts the FileStock page at the /stock/file route
The SKU input on the filing form carries data-testid="sku-input"
The location input on the filing form carries data-testid="location-input"
The quantity input on the filing form carries data-testid="quantity-input"
The inventory code input on the filing form carries data-testid="inventory-code-input"
The form submit button carries data-testid="submit-stock-btn"
Filing a new stock record via the API durably persists it so the record is retrievable with all submitted fields
After a successful filing submission, the confirmation element with data-testid="filing-result" becomes visible
The boundary module (app/routes/) contains no import of any SQLAlchemy ORM class or Session symbol
The service module (app/services/) contains no import of any SQLAlchemy ORM class or Session symbol
The application reads the database DSN exclusively from the DATABASE_URL environment variable; no hardcoded connection string is present in the application source files
A validation error response from the boundary layer identifies the specific offending field by name in its error payload
The service layer raises a rejection for a write where the resulting quantity would be negative before any database call is issued
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a null value in any NOT NULL column raises a constraint violation on the real branch database
Attempting to persist a stock_records row with quantity less than zero raises a CHECK constraint violation on the real branch database
The Alembic downgrade migration removes the stock_records table; a subsequent upgrade recreates it on the real branch database
After the upgrade migration is applied, rows inserted into stock_records are readable with their expected column values on the real branch database
The integration test suite connects to the database exclusively via the DATABASE_URL environment variable pointing at the paired real branch
No integration test uses an in-memory or mocked database driver
Retrieving a previously filed stock record returns the exact quantity and combined inventory_code that were submitted
<App> rendered in MemoryRouter at "/stock/file" shows the retrieved quantity in an element carrying data-testid="result-quantity"
After retrieval, the inventory code display element carries data-testid="result-inventory-code"
No server-side template rendering is present in app/routes/; every response produced by the boundary is JSON
Filing stock for an existing SKU-location pair succeeds without surfacing an error
After filing stock twice for the same SKU-location pair, exactly one record exists for that pair
<App> rendered in MemoryRouter at "/stock/file": after submitting the same SKU and location a second time, no element with data-testid="filing-error" is present in the DOM
After a repeat submission for the same SKU and location pair, the success element with data-testid="filing-result" is present in the DOM
Two writes to the same (sku, location) on the real branch database result in exactly one stored row in stock_records
Two writes to the same (sku, location) executed within a single transaction on the real branch database produce exactly one row in stock_records
When a stock_records row is updated in place by upsert, the created_at timestamp remains unchanged on the real branch database
